sv.title: Högern leder inför spanska valet
sv.summary: Spaniens konservativa parti, PP, och ytterhögerpartiet Vox skulle tillsammans få majoritet i det spanska parlamentet i valet den 29 november enligt tre opinionsundersökningar som publicerades på måndagen. Det rapporterar Reuters.

en.title: The right leads ahead of Spain's election
en.summary: Spain's conservative party, the PP, and the far-right party Vox would together win a majority in the Spanish parliament in the election on 29 November, according to three opinion polls published on Monday. Reuters reports this.
